newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to auction six-month bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to auction six-month bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Saturday it had invited bids up to Tuesday for the auction of six-month maturity short-term federal bonds.

It said the auction result would be announced on Wednesday with settlement set for Thursday. A pre-auction target of five billion rupees had been set but bids could be rejected without giving any reason.

In the last auction on January 22, bids worth 6.202 billion rupees were accepted at a weighted average yield of 16.74163 percent per annum, against a pre-auction target of four billion rupees. -- ($1=40.22 rupees) - Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
